final_response:
> I read this as Implementation - Verify cross-platform release configuration, workflow, and site build/links, then produce the release guide.

### 1. Tauri Configuration & Cargo Check
- `src-tauri/tauri.conf.json` validated via `@tauri-apps/cli` with active multi-platform bundle targets (`dmg`, `app`, `nsis`, `msi`, `appimage`, `deb`) and CSP configuration.
- `cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml` executed cleanly with 0 errors.

### 2. GitHub Actions Release Workflow Structure
- `.github/workflows/release.yml` YAML syntax verified.
- Multi-job architecture verified:
  - `build-desktop`: Matrix builds across `macos-latest` (universal apple-darwin), `windows-latest` (x86_64-pc-windows-msvc), and `ubuntu-latest` (x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu).
  - `build-msix`: Windows MSIX packaging pipeline utilizing `scripts/build-msix.ps1` and `src-tauri/windows/msix/AppxManifest.xml`.
  - `publish-release`: Artifact aggregation, `SHA256SUMS.txt` checksum computation, and GitHub release publication (`softprops/action-gh-release@v2`).

### 3. Landing Page Build & Download Link Verification
- `bun run --cwd site build` succeeded (4 static routes generated + pagefind indexing).
- Added `site/src/lib/downloads.test.ts` verifying all direct download endpoints:
  - macOS DMG: `https://github.com/Indosaram/ferryx/releases/latest/download/Ferryx_aarch64.dmg`, `Ferryx_x64.dmg`, `Ferryx_universal.dmg`
  - Windows: `Ferryx_x64-setup.exe`, `Ferryx_x64.msix`, and Microsoft Store link
  - Linux: `Ferryx_amd64.AppImage`, `Ferryx_amd64.deb`
  - Platform detection logic (`detectUserPlatform`) for macOS, Windows, and Linux user agents.
- Ran `bun test --cwd site` (5/5 tests passing).

### 4. Comprehensive Documentation Deliverable
Created `docs/CROSS_PLATFORM_RELEASE_GUIDE.md` covering:
- Automated git tag (`v*`) and manual `workflow_dispatch` trigger instructions with CLI and UI steps.
- Windows MSIX packaging and Microsoft Partner Center store submission procedure (Identity setup, SDK tools, package upload, IARC rating, store listing).
- Asset naming conventions, direct download endpoint architecture, and checksum verification (`SHA256SUMS.txt`).
- Pre-release and post-release verification checklist.
